assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness
raising clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The episodic nature of these symptoms and the need to correlate rhythm disturbances with clinical events
a cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated to capture arrhythmic activity during symptomatic periods
The service is directly supported by the clinical indication that the study is needed to correlate rhythm disturbances with the palpitations and dizziness documented in the case
